title: Pod Salt Nexus Fizzy Watermelon Gummy Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Fizzy Watermelon Gummy Nic Salt brings together the light, juicy sweetness of Watermelon with a sparkling edge inspired by classic confectionery. The Watermelon note is fresh and delicately sweet, given extra character by a playful, fizzy tang that lifts the flavour into something bright and memorable. Balanced at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable vapes , vape starter kits , and vape pens . The nicotine salt formula provides fast absorption and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, ensuring consistent flavour delivery with discreet vapour. As part of the Pod Salt Nexus range, Fizzy Watermelon Gummy showcases the brand’s talent for bold yet refined flavour blends. Each 10ml bottle is crafted with premium ingredients to deliver reliable quality and lasting taste.
